description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractCandidateActionAPI in the Recruitment API namespace, implementing core logic for candidate-related actions such as updating candidate status, handling transactions, and managing candidate history within a Human Resource Management system. It includes traits for authentication, ORM, date/time, and user role management, and interacts with entities like Candidate, CandidateHistory, CandidateVacancy, Employee, and Vacancy.

classes.name: AbstractCandidateActionAPI
classes.description: An abstract class providing core API functionality for candidate actions such as status updates, candidate history logging, and employee conversion within the recruitment module. It enforces transaction management, permission checks, and defines abstract methods for handling different state transitions.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to retrieve a single candidate record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to provide validation rules for 'getOne' method.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles updating a candidate's status, manages transactions, permission checks, updates candidate vacancy, logs history, possibly creates an employee record if hired, and commits or rolls back transactions.

methods.name: setCandidateHistory
methods.description: Sets properties on CandidateHistory entity based on candidate vacancy and request parameters, including note and interview information.

methods.name: isAuthUserHiringManager
methods.description: Checks if the authenticated user is the hiring manager for the specified vacancy.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for updating candidate data, requiring candidate ID and optionally a note.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to delete candidate record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to validate delete operation.

methods.name: getInterviewId
methods.description: Retrieves interview ID from request parameters, if present.

methods.name: setCandidateAsEmployee
methods.description: Converts a CandidateVacancy into an Employee record, copying relevant details.

methods.name: getResultingState
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to determine the new state after an action.
